task.title: Search All settings
task.shortdesc: Search configured settings, available policies, known preferences, and setting actions from All settings.

prereq.p: Open All settings in any mode.

context.p: Search is shared across Review, Configured, and Catalog work. It can lead to a setting, an action, or a filtered group.

step.cmd: Place focus in the All settings search field.

info.p: Expected result: the All settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Enter a policy ID, preference key, category, source, or plain-language term.

info.p: Expected result: the All settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Choose a grouped result and confirm the target setting or action.

info.p: Expected result: the All settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Clear the search when you return to browsing or filtering.

info.note: Changing settings can affect the exported Firefox policy. Review source, validation, and schema support before saving.

result.p: The matching setting or action is selected without losing the current profile context.

postreq.p: Recovery: if no result appears, confirm the schema channel and try a policy ID or preference key.
